spec.description: Lane pressure, latency, prefix cache, speculative decoding and memory for the Infernix engine on the DGX Spark (infernix-serve /metrics, job dgx-spark-inference).
UP when Prometheus scrapes the engine and it reports infernix_engine_ready = 1. DOWN when the target is unreachable, the engine cannot accept work (/health 503), or there is no data at all.
spec.title: Engine

spec.description: Requests holding a lane now (prefill and decode), out of the lane count (--max-concurrency, 1-8).
spec.title: Lanes busy

spec.description: Requests waiting for initial admission to a lane. Anything above 0 regularly means lanes are saturated: add a lane (--max-concurrency, at most 8) or raise --pending-timeout-ms, since a request that waits longer than that fails with HTTP 503.
spec.title: Waiting for a lane

spec.description: Median time to first token (preparation + queueing + prefill) over the last 5 minutes; idle when no request produced a first token in that window. The lowest histogram bucket is 1 s, so sub-second values are interpolated within 0-1 s.
spec.title: TTFT p50 (5m)

spec.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache over the selected time range (prefill skipped).
spec.title: Prefix cache hit (range)

spec.description: MemAvailable on the Spark, from the Spark collector (Infernix does not export it; not filtered by $instance). Weights, KV pool, n-gram cache and host prefix cache share this unified memory.
spec.title: Spark memory available

spec.description: Requests running and waiting against the lane count. Waiting above 0 means requests queued for a lane.
spec.title: Lane occupancy

spec.description: Occupied share of the Main KV pool (--kv-capacity), shared by every lane. Prefix-cache blocks also occupy it and are evicted on demand, so a fill near 1 is normal once conversations are cached; preemptions, not fill, signal KV pressure.
spec.title: KV pool fill

spec.description: Preparation through first committed token (queueing + binding + prefill), quantiles over 5-minute windows. A cold long prompt takes much longer than a cached follow-up turn. Buckets run from 1 s to 1280 s: sub-second values are interpolated within 0-1 s and anything slower than 1280 s reads as 1280 s.
spec.title: Time to first token

spec.description: Decode tokens per second of decode execution time. Infernix exports no per-request rate histogram, so this is a mean, not a p10/p50/p90: all lanes is the aggregate rate while a decode round runs; per request divides it by the mean decode batch size. 0 means nothing decoded in the window.
spec.title: Decode rate while decoding

spec.description: Generation request duration through settlement, cancellations included, quantiles over 5-minute windows (long answers dominate). Buckets run from 1 s to 1280 s.
spec.title: Request duration

spec.description: Prompt tokens actually computed per second of prefill execution time (cached tokens and queueing excluded). A mean across requests: Infernix exports no per-request prefill histogram. 0 means no prefill ran in the window.
spec.title: Prefill rate while prefilling

spec.description: Generation attempts settling per minute, by outcome (completed, cancelled, failed, rejected). failed and rejected should stay at 0.
spec.title: Finished requests by outcome (per minute)

spec.description: Prompt tokens computed (prefill work), prompt tokens served from the prefix cache, and generated tokens, per second. Prompt tokens are counted once when a request binds; generated tokens are counted live.
spec.title: Token throughput

spec.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache. Drops mean cached conversations were evicted and re-prefilled. 0 means no request bound in the window.
spec.title: Prefix cache hit ratio

spec.description: Prefix-cache tree blocks (all, and those resident in device KV), device blocks no request holds (evictable), and state snapshots a later turn can resume from.
spec.title: Prefix cache contents

spec.description: Share of speculative draft tokens the verify accepted. 0 means no speculative drafts in the window.
spec.title: Draft acceptance

spec.description: Tokens emitted per speculative verification round, computed as accepted drafts per round + 1; 1.0 would mean speculation is not paying. 0 means no speculative rounds in the window.
spec.title: Tokens per verify round

spec.description: Decode rounds per second, stacked by how many requests shared the round (batch 1 = one request decoding alone, up to --max-concurrency). Higher batch sizes mean lanes are sharing the GPU.
spec.title: Decode rounds by batch size

spec.description: MemAvailable, unified memory held by GPU processes (the engine), and the page cache, all from the Spark collector (all hosts; not filtered by $instance). Infernix does not export host memory itself.
spec.title: Spark memory

spec.description: GB10 GPU utilization (left axis) and power draw (right axis), from the Spark collector. Not filtered by $instance.
spec.title: GPU utilization and power (all hosts)

spec.description: Time since the server attached after warm-up (resets on every relaunch).
spec.title: Engine uptime

spec.description: Resident model, speculative backend and KV-cache format serving now.
spec.title: Model

spec.description: Bytes occupied in the pinned host pool that prefix-cache KV blocks and state snapshots share (--host-context-mib).
spec.title: Host prefix cache used

spec.expr: (((sum(increase(infernix_executions_total{instance=~"$instance"}[1m])) == 0) * 0 + 1) and on () (min_over_time(sum(infernix_requests_running{instance=~"$instance"})[1m:10s]) > 0)) or on () (vector(0) and on () (max(up{job="dgx-spark-inference", instance=~"$instance"}) == 1))

spec.description: STALLED when requests have been resident for the last minute but the engine finished no execution unit (prefill chunk or decode round) in that minute. OK otherwise; no data when the engine is not scraped.
spec.title: Engine stalled (while busy)

spec.description: Tokens committed per second across all lanes, counted live as decode rounds deliver them (thinking and control tokens included). Per running request divides the total by the average number of resident requests, which includes requests still in prefill.
spec.title: Generation throughput (live)
DGX Spark Inference (Infernix)
